stock.description: Goldway Education Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, providing diverse academic support services across Hong Kong. The firm's activities are primarily categorized into two distinct segments: primary and secondary education. Its Primary Tutoring Services division targets students from Primary 1 to 6, with the goal of elevating their academic achievement in classroom settings and during assessments, while also reinforcing essential foundational concepts crucial for their ongoing educational journey. Complementing this, the Secondary Tutoring Services segment offers specialized guidance to secondary students from Secondary 1 to 6, designed to help them excel in specific subjects and meticulously prepare for pivotal public examinations. Furthermore, the company extends its business model through franchising services. As of March 31, 2022, Goldway Education Group managed a total of 12 learning centers operating under the brand names Logic Tutorial Centre and Pedagog Education Centre. Founded in 1999, the company is headquartered in Tuen Mun, Hong Kong.
